construct: VIP binds VPAC G-protein-coupled receptors and increases intracellular cAMP in intestinal epithelial and smooth-muscle target tissues. Excess VIP drives intestinal water, electrolyte, and bicarbonate secretion while inhibiting gastric acid secretion, producing fasting-persistent secretory diarrhea, hypokalemia, metabolic acidosis, and hypochlorhydria.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Fasting-persistent high-volume watery diarrhea with hypokalemia, bicarbonate-loss acidosis, hypochlorhydria, and a pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor is the WDHA syndrome of VIPoma.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Somatostatinoma can cause hypochlorhydria and diarrhea/steatorrhea, but it does not classically produce the severe fasting-persistent secretory diarrhea and profound potassium/bicarbonate loss of VIP excess.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The WDHA pattern plus pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor makes VIPoma uniquely best.
